verdict.rationale: The Better Auth homepage claims enterprise readiness with "SSO, SAML 2.0, SCIM, and directory sync" (docs-62). A community commenter corroborates SAML/SCIM support but notes some of these features are enterprise-only (comm-17). The pack has no SCIM plugin documentation, endpoints, or setup guide, so the depth of the capability is unproven. Missing for 10: dedicated SCIM docs, evidence of group/team sync, evidence that IdP deprovisioning revokes sessions or access, clarity on which tier includes SCIM, and hands-on corroboration.
